CDLI P464355 – Laws of Lipit-Ištar, composite (RIME 4.01.05.add10), with 13 exemplars

  • Text: the Laws of Lipit-Ištar (LI), king of Isin (c. 1934–1924 BCE): prologue, laws, epilogue (blessings and curses) and colophon. Sumerian, known from Old Babylonian school copies (Nippur and elsewhere).
  • Edition: CDLI composite P464355 = Q000613, "RIME 4.01.05.add10 (Codex Lipit-Ishtar) composite"; CDLI cites RIME 4 (1990) and C. Wilcke, "Gesetze in sumerischer Sprache", Fs Krecher (2014/2015), 455–612, on which the composite is based. Transliteration and an English translation on every line (#tr.en; translator not named). No normalization (Sumerian). Roth 1997 (SBL WAW 6) and Steele 1948 are not owned.
  • Exemplars: 13 (ex. 01–13), their ATF embedded in the composite's JSON and saved here as P<id>.atf: ex. 01 AO 5473 (P345378), ex. 02 UM 29-16-55+ (P256663, the large Nippur prism/tablet), ex. 03 CBS 13632+ (P263136), ex. 04 CBS 11352 (P266503), ex. 05 CBS 2158 (P259227), ex. 06 N 3320 (P278364), ex. 07 Ist Ni 9770 (P343416), ex. 08 CBS 8326 (P263166), ex. 09 AO 10624 (P344879), ex. 10 CBS 6802 (P264255), ex. 11 BM 54326 (P357182), ex. 12 CBS 8284 (P467648), ex. 13 UM 29-15-448 (P256242). Each exemplar line links (>>Q000613 <label>) to its composite line.
  • URLs: https://cdli.earth/artifacts/464355 · JSON export https://cdli.earth/artifacts/464355/json.
  • Retrieved: 2026-10-18.

Numbering

  • Composite lines 1–107′ prologue (the prime marks start after a break), 108′–429′ laws, 430′–500′ epilogue, 501′–503′ colophon (CDLI labels; $ n lines broken gaps).
  • Laws @law N = Roth 1997's numbering, with Wilcke's lettered additions (§7a, §20a–c, §21a–b, §23a–b, §32a): §4–§38 in the composite (§1–§3 are lost in the gap). Cite as "LI §25 (… lines)".

Usefulness

Base text of חוקים-ובריתות/5-חוקי-ליפית-אישתר/. Good (35 lines with [ ]). Lexicon: ePSD2 (ORACC/_bulk/epsd2-literary.zip, per form) and ETCSL's lemmatized TEI for formulas.
